name: TC24 - 输出变量传递 + 错误路径（模块G-H, 7条）
description: 后端API/DB级测试。模块G: 输出变量传递(4条)；模块H: 错误路径(3条)。pytest脚本: test_approve_regression.py。涉及g_workflow_instance.common_variable和workflow_record_log查询。

steps.description: 打开个人任务中心（获取登录态cookie）

steps.sql: SELECT wi.id, JSON_EXTRACT(wi.common_variable, '$.passedImg') as passed_img FROM g_workflow_instance wi WHERE wi.id > 4000000 AND JSON_EXTRACT(wi.common_variable, '$.passedImg') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY wi.id DESC LIMIT 5

steps.condition: all_rows.passed_img is not null AND all_rows.passed_img != ''

steps.sql: SELECT id, JSON_EXTRACT(output_json, '$.passedImg1') as img1, JSON_EXTRACT(output_json, '$.passedImg2') as img2, JSON_EXTRACT(output_json, '$.passedImg3') as img3, JSON_EXTRACT(output_json, '$.passedImg4') as img4, JSON_EXTRACT(output_json, '$.passedImg5') as img5 FROM workflow_record_log WHERE id > 4000000 AND node_type='approve' AND status='SUCCESS' AND JSON_EXTRACT(output_json, '$.passedImg1') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 3
steps.description: NEW-G2: 查询套图审核output_json中的独立URL字段

steps._comment: NEW-G3: refreshSubTaskMaterialUrls URL刷新 — 高清化后URL正确传递
steps.sql: SELECT r1.id, r1.status, JSON_EXTRACT(r1.output_json, '$.passedImg') as passed_img, JSON_EXTRACT(r1.output_json, '$.materialUrls') as material_urls FROM workflow_record_log r1 WHERE r1.id > 4000000 AND r1.node_type='approve' AND r1.status='SUCCESS' AND JSON_EXTRACT(r1.extra_info, '$.hdEnhanced') = 'true' ORDER BY r1.id DESC LIMIT 3
steps.description: NEW-G3: 查询高清化后URL是否正确刷新到output
NEW-G3: 高清化后passedImg URL已正确刷新传递

steps.sql: SELECT id, JSON_EXTRACT(output_json, '$.approvedTaoCate') as approved_cate FROM workflow_record_log WHERE id > 4000000 AND node_type='approve' AND status='SUCCESS' AND JSON_EXTRACT(output_json, '$.approvedTaoCate') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 3

steps.condition: all_rows.approved_cate is not null AND all_rows.approved_cate != ''

steps.sql: SELECT id, status, JSON_EXTRACT(extra_info, '$.errorMsg') as error_msg FROM workflow_record_log WHERE id > 4000000 AND node_type='approve' AND status='FAIL' AND JSON_EXTRACT(extra_info, '$.errorMsg') LIKE '%没有要审核的图片%' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 5
steps.description: NEW-H1: 查询因无图片而FAIL的record

steps.condition: all_rows.status == 'FAIL' AND all_rows.error_msg contains '没有要审核的图片'
steps.description: NEW-H1: status=FAIL, errorMsg含"没有要审核的图片"

steps.sql: SELECT id, status, JSON_EXTRACT(extra_info, '$.retryCount') as retry_count, JSON_EXTRACT(extra_info, '$.errorMsg') as error_msg FROM workflow_record_log WHERE id > 4000000 AND node_type='approve' AND (status='RETRYING' OR (status='FAIL' AND JSON_EXTRACT(extra_info, '$.errorMsg') LIKE '%Concurrency%')) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 5
steps.description: NEW-H2: 查找并发问题相关的record

steps.condition: all matching rows status == 'RETRYING' OR retry_count > 0

steps._comment: NEW-H3: bandId/linkId非法→warn不中断 — 其他record继续处理
steps.sql: SELECT id, status, JSON_EXTRACT(extra_info, '$.warnMsg') as warn_msg FROM workflow_record_log WHERE id > 4000000 AND JSON_EXTRACT(extra_info, '$.warnMsg') LIKE '%illegal%bandId%' OR JSON_EXTRACT(extra_info, '$.warnMsg') LIKE '%illegal%linkId%' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 5

steps.description: NEW-H3: bandId/linkId非法时仅warn，record不进入FAIL，其他record继续处理

steps.sql: SELECT r1.id, r1.status, JSON_EXTRACT(r1.common_variable, '$.batchId') as batch_id FROM workflow_record_log r1 WHERE r1.id > 4000000 AND JSON_EXTRACT(r1.common_variable, '$.batchId') IN (SELECT JSON_EXTRACT(common_variable, '$.batchId') FROM workflow_record_log WHERE id > 4000000 AND JSON_EXTRACT(extra_info, '$.warnMsg') LIKE '%illegal%') AND r1.status='SUCCESS' LIMIT 5

steps.description: NEW-H3: 非法ID仅warn，同batch其他record继续正常处理
